description: Merges per-run complexity weights over the locked defaults and rescales them to sum to 1.0.
signature: def resolve_complexity_weights(defaults: Mapping[str, float], override: Mapping[str, float] | None) -> dict[str, float]
docstring:
Merge user-chosen complexity weights over the locked defaults.

Features missing from `override` keep their default, then the whole vector is rescaled to sum to 1.0. When the result equals the defaults, the defaults are returned unchanged.

Raises:
    ParameterError: unknown feature, non-number, negative or non-finite value, or all weights zero.
preconditions: defaults is the locked weight mapping and sums to 1.0
postconditions: Returned weights have exactly the keys of defaults and sum to 1.0

edge_cases.input: NaN, inf, negative or non-number value
